create_qhadam_optimizer: create a QHAdamOptimizer instance with custom learning rate, nu1, nu2, beta1, and beta2 hyperparameters
create_qhadam_from_nadam: create a QHAdamOptimizer configured to recover NAdam behavior using the from_nadam classmethod
apply_dense_gradients: apply dense gradient updates to TensorFlow variables using the QHAdamOptimizer _apply_dense method
apply_sparse_gradients: apply sparse gradient updates to TensorFlow variables using the QHAdamOptimizer _apply_sparse method
convert_params_to_dict: convert QHAdam parameter object to a dictionary with learning_rate, nu1, nu2, beta1, and beta2 keys
